name: context-points
description: Scrum adapted for teams made of agents: story points become a context budget, planning poker runs blind to detect ambiguity, and the Definition of Done is a list of commands.

skills.name: context-points
skills.description: The Context Points methodology: Scrum adapted for agent teams, where the scarce resource is context rather than time. Use when planning, estimating, refining, reviewing or retrospecting work executed by AI agents; when deciding how to split work across subagents; or when someone asks how to run a sprint, a backlog or a Definition of Done for a team of agents.

skills.name: context-points-estimation
skills.description: The context-point scale and the blind estimation protocol. Use when sizing a story for an agent, deciding whether work fits in one session, choosing between a story and a spike, or running planning poker across isolated agent contexts.
